title: Equipment Sold for a Car Rental That Is Never Collected
content:
Equipment sold for a rental on the Car Rental Rate Classes that is never collected is returned before the release share is taken. The equipment lines are the satellite navigation, child seat, snow chains and ski rack lines standing on the rental's ledger, added together.

**The return schedule.**

| What stands on the ledger, and when the rental is given up | What is returned |
|---|---|
| Equipment lines standing, the rental given up 3 or more whole days before the scheduled collection | Every equipment line in full, taken out of the money the share acts on |
| Equipment lines standing, the rental given up fewer than 3 whole days before the scheduled collection | 0.5 of those lines, taken out of the money the share acts on |
| No equipment line standing | Nothing |

Where 0.5 of the equipment lines is returned, the half so arrived at is rounded to two decimal places at that step.

**Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical ledgers.** A rental carrying 130 of equipment lines and given up exactly 3 whole days before the scheduled collection returns the whole 130, and the money the share acts on is smaller by 130. Given up 2 whole days before, the same rental returns 65.00, and the money the share acts on is smaller by 65.00. A rental carrying 45.99 of equipment lines given up 1 whole day before returns 23.00, that being half of 45.99 rounded to two decimal places. A rental carrying no equipment line at all returns nothing, however far ahead it is given up.
